nodes.label: Two Backends Coexistence Decision
nodes.rationale: Explicit decision to keep both the live Next.js/Supabase app and the NestJS+TypeORM `/backend` migration target side by side for now — this is not a cutover in progress, it's two things that exist together until the team decides otherwise. Don't assume code in one implies the other is current; they're maintained by different passes.

nodes.label: Missing CRON_SECRET Risk
nodes.rationale: Without CRON_SECRET set, scheduled cron jobs (/api/cron/*) 401 silently, every day, forever — called out as the highest-impact missing config for a real deploy.

nodes.label: Switching Resume Storage to SharePoint
nodes.rationale: Code (src/lib/integrations/sharepoint.ts, src/lib/resumeStorage.ts) was built and tested as far as possible without a real Microsoft 365 tenant: default Supabase path confirmed unchanged, SharePoint mode confirmed to fail with a clear specific error rather than crash or silently no-op. Real upload/download against an actual tenant was never tested — flagged as the one piece of the handover needing a human with real M365 access.

nodes.label: AI Provider Nuance — NVIDIA Kimi Tool-Call Degeneration
nodes.rationale: Only NVIDIA has ever been live-tested (no Anthropic key was ever available). Confirmed across 6+ live request variations: NVIDIA's moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 reliably calls a tool but degenerates into repeated tokens a meaningful fraction of the time right after consuming the tool's result. Reliable for single-shot generation only, which is why the daily digest uses single-shot, not tool-calling. Mitigations (penalty params + looksDegenerate() fallback) reduce but don't eliminate the failure rate — prefer Anthropic once a key exists.

nodes.label: Backend (NestJS) Status
nodes.rationale: Every entity carries is_deleted/deleted_at via BaseEntity but no live Supabase table has those columns today, so pointing this backend at production data will fail until a migration adds them. Auth provider is switching from Supabase Auth to Clerk, requiring a one-time user-mapping script before any existing account can log in. Most of the app isn't ported yet.

nodes.label: Cost-Efficient Deployment Recommendations
nodes.rationale: Recommends Vercel (Hobby free / Pro $20/seat for commercial-use compliance), keeping the existing Supabase project rather than provisioning a second Postgres for the NestJS backend, Fly.io/Railway for NestJS compute, Clerk once migrated, and SharePoint for resume storage — realistic total $2-7/month on free tiers, $25-32/month if Vercel Pro/Supabase paid tier are needed.

nodes.label: Migration Sprint (2026-07-07) — Neon + Cloudflare Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Strategy: Hybrid Option A — Neon becomes the main app database while Supabase Auth and Storage remain temporarily; full auth/storage independence deferred to a future Phase 2 sprint.
